technique_name: Explain the changes from Donald Trump’s administration to Joe Biden’s administration in regards to foreign relations.
description: Under the Trump administration, the United States withdrew from the World Health Organization, Paris Agreement, Trans-Pacific Partnership, and other international agreements, and imposed sanctions on Iran, Cuba and other countries. In opposition, President Biden has declared that America is "back" and ready to lead the world, and has taken a number of steps to reassure allies and reset relations with adversaries.
